text:
maria: Heads up, prebake window starting in 20m. I'll kick off the prebake job for quant-kernel v3.2.
kevin: thx. can we enable the deadman switch for the first 2 hours? last time we saw slow regressions that only tripped after 30m.
maria: yes planning to. using deploybot: /deploy prebake quant-kernel:v3.2 --bake --deadman=2h
deploybot: deploy request received. Prebake job queued on staging-pool-7. ETA ~8m. Monitoring: https://internal/ci/1234
tara: if prebake passes, what's the routing shim plan for fallback? auto-failover to v3.1 or skip to float-quant-compat?
kevin: prefer auto->v3.1 for first slice, then float-compat for region fallback. keep canary at 3% for 30m.
maria: agreed. routing config snippet I will push:
```
routes:
  - slice: canary
    weight: 3
    target: quant-kernel:v3.2
    fallback: quant-kernel:v3.1
  - slice: regional
    weight: 97
    target: quant-kernel:float-compat
```
jim: add a telemetry gate: latency p95 increase < 5% AND error_rate < 0.3% across slice.
maria: noted. alert on slack: #eng-runtime and #incidents if gate fails.
ops-bot: prebake started on node g4dn-08. Job id: pb-7742. Logs: https://logs/pb-7742
tara: quick ask — ensure release notes call out the quant matrix change and kernel ABI bump.
kevin: yes add line: "quant-kernel v3.2 introduces matmul reorder + ABI minor bump; v3.1 fallback available."
maria: will draft release notes and ping docs for the rollback snippet.
kevin: on the deadman, set deploybot to auto-pin v3.1 if metric gate tripped: /deploybot set-deadman pb-7742 --on-fail=pin:quant-kernel:v3.1
maria: exactly.
deploybot: prebake pb-7742: smoke tests passed. perf-run in progress (10m).
ops-bot: perf run partial: p95 down 2%, memory steady, kv-hit-rate -0.5%, no errors so far.
kevin: nice. keep an eye on KV cache evictions — last time correlated with p99 spikes.
maria: will monitor. if anything odd, I'll abort with: /deploy abort pb-7742 --reason="kv-eviction-anomaly"
jim: documenting rollback steps for oncall: 1) pin v3.1, 2) re-route canary, 3) rebuild prebake with --no-matmul-reorder
tara: added to release notes draft and oncall playbook. ping me when prebake completes.
maria: prebake perf finished. metrics within thresholds. moving to staged canary rollout per plan. starting rollout now.
deploybot: rollout initiated: quant-kernel:v3.2 -> canary 3% for 30m. track id: r-9921
ops-bot: monitor: initial 5m metrics OK. gating checks scheduled at 15m and 30m.
kevin: I'll sit on 15m and 30m checks. if any drift, manual pin+rollback.
maria: thanks team. I'll update the release notes with final perf numbers and close the thread after 1h.
